caption: The drawing features a detailed architectural ornament rendered in grayscale. The object is a sculptural element composed of a large volute (spiral scroll), adorned with acanthus leaves and intricate floral patterns. The largest scroll is positioned at the left side of the drawing, with the ornament tapering off to the right. The primary material appears to mimic stone or carved wood. The leaves and scrolls are shaded to emphasize depth and dimension, and there is a rectangular base beneath the ornament indicating it is likely intended to sit atop a surface. The background is plain and unornamented, allowing the central decorative object to stand out prominently. The entire work uses shades of gray and lacks any color, creating a monochromatic appearance.
title: Billethead from Frigate "Sabine"
